description: This is a Java class named MerchantStore representing a merchant's store entity within the SalesManager e-commerce platform. It includes properties such as store name, code, contact info, location details, language, currency, and templates, along with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: MerchantStore
classes.description: Entity class representing a merchant's store with ORM annotations mapping it to the 'MERCHANT_STORE' database table. It encapsulates store details like name, address, contact, location, language, currency, templates, and associated entities.
